# Vocabulary: player_role

The fiction-level role the player occupies relative to the simulation.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `god` | God | Supernatural actor above the world, acting through powers. |
| `planner-mayor` | Planner / mayor | Civic planner shaping land use and services. |
| `manager-owner` | Manager / owner | Runs a business, facility, or team. |
| `overseer` | Overseer | Directs a group of semi-autonomous individuals (colony, crew, dwarves). |
| `ruler-statesman` | Ruler / statesman | Head of a polity or dynasty. |
| `commander` | Commander | Directs military forces. |
| `operator-pilot` | Operator / pilot | Directly operates a machine or vehicle. |
| `inhabitant` | Inhabitant | Lives inside the world as one embodied character. |
| `caretaker` | Caretaker | Tends creatures, plants, or a household. |
| `engineer-designer` | Engineer / designer | Designs machines, structures, or production systems. |
| `programmer` | Programmer | Writes code or logic the simulation executes. |
| `observer-gardener` | Observer / gardener | Seeds initial conditions and watches; intervention is sparse. |
| `worker` | Worker | Performs an occupation's hands-on tasks. |
